notes: Item 7 (targeted) excerpt was empty, so no MD&A paragraphs matched the theme terms. Recognition as a 'Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion' by Disability:IN is an external accolade with no underlying practice described, so it was recorded only here and not scored. The VWR private label offering for 'more than 5,000 suppliers' and the channel access given to suppliers concern established life sciences suppliers that are not described as small businesses or founders, so they were not counted for Entrepreneurship. The 'education & government' end market and 'education ... kits' are product sales to education customers, not education delivered as a business, so they were not counted for Community. The Responsible Supplier Program covers sustainability collaboration with suppliers, not community or education, and was not scored. Values and mission language (ICARE, 'setting science in motion') is general language only.
